text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of Jardiance include increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Increased urination: Passing more urine or needing to go more often happens because the medication removes extra sugar through your kidneys.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Extra sugar in the urine can help bacteria grow, causing burning or pain when you pee.
Genital yeast infections: These can affect both women and men, causing itching, discomfort, or redness.
Upper respiratory tract infections: Mild cold-like symptoms, such as a stuffy nose or sore throat.
Increased thirst and mild dehydration: Losing extra fluid can make you feel thirsty or slightly dizzy.
Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, marked by nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and trouble breathing.
Severe dehydration and low blood pressure: Can cause dizziness, fainting, or sudden worsening of kidney function.
Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier’s gangrene): A rare, serious, and painful tissue infection in the genital and anal area.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if you take Jardiance along with insulin or other diabetes medications.
Lower limb amputations: A rare risk involving new pain, sores, or infections in the legs or feet.
Serious allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or trouble breathing.
